title: 8 Psalms a Godly Man Prays When He Has No Words
caption:
8 Psalms a godly man prays when he has no words.

You don't have to find the right thing to say. David already wrote it down, and God keeps hearing men who borrow his words.

Save this for the night you can't pray. Which one do you need first?
